Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. (16, 7, 81)

(24, 16, 64)

In the following question, select the missing number from the given series.

67, 46, 24, 1, –23, ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is : **Consecutive number series is subtracted subsequently.**

⇒ 67 - 21 = 46

⇒ 46 - 22 = 24

⇒ 24 - 23 = 1

⇒ 1 - 24 = - 23

⇒ -23 - 25 = **-48**

Hence, **"(-48)"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

Some pencils are rods.

No rod is a door.

All balls are rods.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some pencils being balls is a possibility.

II. No ball is a door.

III. All rods are balls.

IV. No pencil is a door.

options.text: Only Conclusions I, II and IV follow
Only Conclusions I and II follow
Only Conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62072659bedbe6b9bdcb0e0e6b7eb70f42310348dd22a3b38124c35637904b5e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some pencils being balls is a possibility → Follow (As some pencils are rods and all balls are rods. So, as no direct negative or cross relation is given between pencils and balls therefore it is definitely possible)

II. No ball is a door → Follow (As all balls are rods and no rod is a door. So, a direct negative or cross relation is given between door and rod in which whole balls comes in therefore it is definitely true)

III. All rods are balls → Does not follow (As all balls are rods and no rod is a door. So, a direct negative or cross relation is given between door and rod in which whole balls comes in therefore it is definitely false)

IV. No pencil is a door → Does not follow (As some pencils are rods and no rod is a door. So, as no direct negative or cross relation is given between pencils and door therefore it is definitely false)

∴ Here, Only conclusions I and II follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Only conclusions I and II follow"

Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. No A is B.

II. No C is B.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some C are not A.

II. Some A are B.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e38ccb7bc027e45444762eefd59eeaa08ac05f2f1997338cccc4ce0143c6e1a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some C are not A → **Does not f**ollow (As no A is B and no C is B. So, as no direct negative or cross relation is given between C and A therefore it is definitely false)

II. Some A are B → Does not follow (As no A is B. So, a direct negative or cross relation is given between A and B therefore it is definitely false)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusion follows**"

questions.question: Select the odd group of numbers. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13 - Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

Select the option that is related to the fourth term in the same way as the first term is related to the second term and the fifth term is related to the sixth term.

16 : 96 :: ? : 161 :: 18 : 120
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is : [**1st number × (1number + 2)] ÷ 3 = 2nd number **

So,

 
• 16 : 96

​[16 × (16 +2)] ÷ 3 = 96 

(16 × 18) ÷ 3 = 96

96 = 96 (LHS = RHS)

And,

 
• 18 : 120​

[​18 × (18 +2)] ÷ 3 = 120 

[​18 × (18 +2)] = 120 × 3

18 × 20 = 360

360 = 360 (LHS = RHS)

Similarly,

 
• ? : 161​

​Let '?' be 'x'

​x × (x +2) = 161 × 3

x² + 2x = 483

x² + 2x - 483 = 0 

x2 + 23x - 21x - 483 = 0

(x + 23) (x - 21) = 0

x = either - 23 or 21

 

As, the answer cannot be negative, therefore value of x will be 21.

Hence, **"21"** is the correct answer.

__
 
• **Please note that, in this kind of question we have to replace the digits on the right-hand side too that's why 5 is replaced by 10 in the given solution.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

Given equation : **28 + 7 × 10 ÷ 5 - 20 = 5**

According to the question, after** ****interchanging of numbers and mathematical signs:**

So,

 
• Option - (1) : 10 and 20, × and +

28 × 7 + **20 ÷ 5**__ - 10 = 5

__**28 ×**____** 7**__ + 4 - 10 = 5

__**196 + 4**__ - 10 = 5

__**200 - 10**__ = 5

190 ≠ 5 (LHS ≠ RHS)

__
 
• Option - (2) : 5 and 20, - and ÷

28 + 7 × 10 - **20 ÷ 5**__ = 20

28 + __**7 × 10**__ - 4 = 20

__**28 + 70**__ - 4 = 20

__**98 - 4**__ = 20

94 ≠ 20 (LHS ≠ RHS)

__
 
• Option - (3) : 7 and 28, × and ÷

7 + **28 ÷ 10**__ × 5 - 20 = 5

7 + __**2.8 ×**____** 5**__ - 20 = 5

__**7 + 14**__ - 20 = 5

__**18 - 20**__ = 5

-2 ≠ 5 (LHS ≠ RHS)

__
 
• Option - (4) : 5 and 10, + and ÷

**28 ÷ 7**__ × 5 + 10 - 20 = 10

__**4 × 5**__ + 10 - 20 = 10

__**20 + 10 **__- 20 = 10

__**30 - 20**__ = 10

10 = 10 (LHS = RHS)

Hence, "Option - (4)" is the correct answer.
